Your style expertise, warm communication, and ability to create highly personalized experiences will help clients feel like they have a trusted Stylist at their fingertips. Whether you’re offering advice for a special occasion, helping a client complete a look, or introducing new items they’ll love, you’ll deliver joy and style while helping shape the future of the Stitch Fix client experience.

This is a remote, hourly, part-time Flex Tier Stylist role requiring 10–20 hours per week, with scheduling flexibility to align with client demand as directed by Stitch Fix.

Responsibilities

  • Provide expert style guidance across evolving client channels, including messaging, chat, video, and our in-house styling platform, responding to client requests and creating personalized looks that build confidence and trust.
  • Create thoughtfully styled assortments by leveraging client profiles, preferences, past purchases, style goals, and our ever-fresh inventory, crafting unique Fixes that delight and inspire clients across all shapes, sizes, gender identities, style spectrums, occasions, and lifestyles.
  • Build meaningful client relationships through personalized interactions and a public-facing Stylist profile featuring your photo, which helps clients connect with you and may also be used in Stitch Fix marketing to showcase the human element of our service.
  • Deliver against performance, productivity, and client satisfaction goals while identifying opportunities to strengthen client retention and Stylist-client connections and sharing insights with the broader team.
  • Develop your styling expertise by participating in training and regular check-ins, staying current on company updates and fashion trends, and contributing to a supportive, collaborative styling community that embraces diverse styles and continuous feedback.

How AI and tools show up in your day-to-day work

Technology is an important part of how you’ll deliver personalized experiences at scale. You’ll use Stitch Fix’s in-house styling platform and other digital tools to understand client preferences, create personalized recommendations, communicate with clients, and work efficiently in a remote environment.

You’ll be expected to quickly learn and apply new technologies, including evolving AI-enabled tools and features, as they are introduced. You’ll use these tools to improve efficiency and outcomes while applying your own style expertise, judgment, and human connection to create an experience that feels uniquely personal to each client.

About You

This is what you’ll need to succeed in this role from day 1.

Requirements

  • 2+ years of client-facing styling or apparel experience, with enthusiasm for fashion and a demonstrated ability to create positive customer experiences.
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding performance goals in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Excellent written communication skills and the ability to build rapport and trust with clients in a virtual environment.
  • Experience and confidence styling across body types, gender identities, lifestyles, style preferences, and occasions.
  • Ability to rapidly adopt new tools, technologies, and processes and integrate them into your workflow with minimal downtime.
  • Familiarity with Google Workspace, including Docs and Gmail, Slack, and Zoom, or the ability to quickly learn new tools and systems.
  • A reliable computer with a Chrome browser and high-speed cable or fiber internet with a minimum speed of 10 Mbps.
  • Strong time-management skills, including punctual attendance, accurate timekeeping, and productive work habits that meet operational requirements.
  • Ability to consistently meet the 10–20 hour weekly requirement for this part-time, hourly, Flex Tier Stylist role, with scheduling flexibility to align with client demand as directed by Stitch Fix.
  • A commitment to actively seeking feedback and continuously improving your work for yourself, your clients, and your team.
  • Ability and willingness to maintain a public-facing Stylist profile featuring your photo, which may be used to support client relationships and in Stitch Fix marketing.
  • This position may require the ability to sit for extended periods of time, use a computer or other office equipment, and communicate effectively (verbal and written).

Nice to Have

  • Experience delivering personalized styling or customer experiences through digital channels such as messaging, chat, or video.

Join Us as a Clinical Research Associate (Level II) – Make an Impact at the Forefront of Innovation

As part of our global team, you’ll have the opportunity to perform and coordinate all aspects of the clinical monitoring and site management process. What You'll Do:

  • Ensures data accuracy through SDR, SDV and CRF review as applicable through on-site and remote monitoring activities. Assess investigational product through physical inventory and records review. Documents observations in reports and letters in a timely manner using approved business writing standards.

Experience

  • In some cases an equivalency, consisting of a combination of appropriate education, training and/or directly related experience, will be considered sufficient for an individual to meet the requirements of the role.

Knowledge, Skills, Abilities

  • Demonstrated understanding of medical/therapeutic area knowledge and medical terminology\

  • Demonstrated ability to attain and maintain a working knowledge of ICH GCPs, applicable regulations and procedural documents

  • Well-developed critical thinking skills, including but not limited to: critical mindset, in-depth investigation for appropriate root cause analysis and problem solving

We're looking for a highly analytical, results-driven Paid Ads Specialist to manage and scale paid acquisition campaigns for medical and aesthetic practices.
You'll own Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other paid channels, with a clear focus on generating qualified patient leads and measurable revenue, not just clicks or impressions.
This is a hands-on performance marketing role for someone who understands both the technical and strategic sides of paid media, including campaign optimization, conversion tracking, attribution, budget management, and landing page performance.
Why This Opportunity?
  • Take ownership of paid acquisition campaigns across Google Ads and Meta Ads.
  • Manage meaningful advertising budgets with direct responsibility for performance.
  • Work with multiple client accounts in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Focus on measurable business outcomes, including qualified leads, conversions, and revenue.
  • Collaborate with SEO, creative, and account management teams across the full marketing funnel.
  • Build specialized expertise in performance marketing for medical and aesthetic businesses.
What You'll Do
Paid Media Management
  • Build, launch, manage, and continuously optimize Google Ads, including Search, Performance Max, Display, and YouTube campaigns.
  • Manage Meta Ads campaigns across Facebook and Instagram.
  • Conduct keyword research, competitor analysis, and audience targeting tailored to healthcare decision-makers.
  • Manage campaign budgets, bids, and bidding strategies to maximize ROAS and cost-per-lead efficiency.
  • Write high-converting ad copy while maintaining compliance with medical advertising guidelines and platform policies.
Tracking & Performance Optimization
  • Set up and maintain accurate conversion tracking using Google Tag Manager, conversion tracking tools, call tracking, and CRM/EMR integrations.
  • Analyze campaign performance weekly and provide clear recommendations based on patient acquisition and revenue impact.
  • Troubleshoot tracking issues and campaign underperformance quickly.
  • Monitor platform updates, algorithm changes, and healthcare-specific advertising best practices.
  • Support landing page and conversion rate optimization initiatives.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
  • Collaborate with account managers, SEO specialists, and creative teams to align paid media with the broader marketing funnel.
  • Communicate campaign performance and recommendations clearly to internal stakeholders.
  • Manage multiple client accounts simultaneously while maintaining strong organization and attention to detail.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications
  • 2+ years of hands-on paid media experience, with agency experience strongly preferred.
  • Proven track record managing Google Ads accounts with meaningful budget responsibility.
  • Strong understanding of conversion tracking, attribution, and the factors that drive qualified leads versus vanity metrics.
  • Strong working knowledge of Google Ads and Google Analytics.
  • Analytical mindset with experience using spreadsheet-based reporting.
  • Excellent written communication skills for ad copy and client-facing reporting.
  • Ability to manage multiple client accounts simultaneously in a fast-paced agency environment.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to prioritize effectively.
Preferred Qualifications
  • Experience running paid campaigns for medical, aesthetic, or professional service clients.
  • Hands-on Meta Ads (Facebook/Instagram) experience.
  • Familiarity with call-tracking platforms and CRM integrations.
  • Knowledge of healthcare compliance considerations in digital advertising.
  • Experience with Performance Max, Demand Gen, or advanced Google Ads features.
  • Basic understanding of landing page conversion rate optimization.

Success in this role will be measured by your ability to:
  • Generate qualified patient leads through paid acquisition campaigns.
  • Improve ROAS and cost-per-lead efficiency across client accounts.
  • Maintain accurate conversion tracking and attribution.
  • Optimize advertising budgets based on measurable business outcomes.
  • Identify and resolve campaign performance issues quickly.
  • Deliver clear, actionable performance insights and recommendations.
  • Successfully manage multiple client accounts while maintaining quality and attention to detail.
Why Join Us?

  • Competitive compensation of $1,500 – $2,500 USD/month.
  • Hands-on ownership of performance marketing campaigns.
  • Work across Google Ads, Meta Ads, analytics, and conversion optimization.
  • Gain specialized experience within medical and aesthetic marketing.
  • Collaborative environment connecting paid media directly to measurable client revenue.

jobs.description:
Mactores is the agent-native AWS modernization firm. Most modernization work doesn't ship, it stalls in pilots, slips a year, or lands at three times the budget. We exist to ship it: production systems running, legacy retired, outcomes measured. Our delivery is built on Aedeon, the agent platform built by Mactores' founders' sister company, which absorbs the repetitive 60–70% of engagement work, discovery, dependency mapping, validation, test generation, that traditional consulting bills human hours against. Forward-deployed engineers own the rest: architecture, judgment, and cutover, on dates we commit to in the contract.

Enterprises stuck on Oracle carry license renewals, vendor-specific SQL nobody wants to touch, and application layers welded to the database underneath them. This role sits in our Application & Database Modernization pillar: you'll work an Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration where Aedeon handles the mechanical conversion at scale and you own what the tools can't the refactoring judgment inside large enterprise Java codebases. You'll rewrite the SQL the application actually depends on, align it with the modernized schema, prove functional parity, and see the application through production cutover. Not a proof of concept. A system that ships.

What you will do?

  • Analyze and remediate large enterprise Java codebases — replace legacy and database-specific SQL constructs with modern, standards-compliant SQL.
  • Convert embedded SQL in Java services and MyBatis XML mappers: rewrite vendor-specific functions, sequences, pagination logic, dynamic SQL, and error-handling patterns.
  • Work closely with schema and database migration engineers so application-layer SQL lands aligned with the modernized target schema.
  • Refactor Java transaction logic, error handling, drivers, and ORM/DAO layers to match the behavior of modern databases.
  • Run unit, integration, and performance testing to confirm functional parity and hit performance SLAs post-modernization.
  • Support production cutover — validation, monitoring setup, rollback planning, and stabilization until the system holds.
  • Produce engineering documentation that outlives the engagement: SQL remediation guides, code-migration runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge-transfer material for customer teams.
  • Work across distributed teams (US and India) and with customer SMEs to keep business logic aligned and the modernization on track.

What are we looking for?

  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of professional Java development experience (Spring, JDBC, MyBatis/Hibernate or equivalent).
  • Experience with application modernization, database migrations, or large-scale refactoring initiatives.
  • Strong SQL expertise you can analyze, interpret, optimize, and rewrite complex SQL embedded in Java applications.
  • Deep understanding of JDBC, ORMs, Java transaction patterns, and database-driven application flows.
  • Experience on enterprise-grade, high-performance applications with complex data interactions.
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to work with global distributed teams in US time zones.

You will be preferred if

  • Experience with PostgreSQL, Aurora PostgreSQL, or modernization from legacy databases such as Oracle, SQL Server, or DB2.
  • Exposure to automated code-refactoring tools or GenAI-assisted remediation workflows.
  • Familiarity with CI/CD environments, performance testing tools, and observability stacks.
  • Consulting or professional services experience delivering fixed-timeline modernization projects.

How we work?

    Agents do the repetitive 60–70% of the work a traditional consulting engagement of equivalent scope staffs humans for. Engineers do the rest, and the rest is the interesting part. You won't spend months grinding through mechanical SQL conversion; Aedeon and its regression harness cover that. Your hours go to refactoring judgment, risk tradeoffs, production cutover, and post-cutover optimization. We commit to delivery dates and absorb the overage cost for delays inside our control, which means the engineering has to be right the first time. That's the job.

Life at Mactores

We care about creating a culture that makes a real difference in the lives of every Mactorian. Our 10 Core Leadership Principles that honor Decision-making, Leadership, Collaboration, and Curiosity drive how we work.

Voyager is an innovative space, defense, and national security technology company committed to advancing and delivering transformative, mission-critical solutions. We tackle the most complex challenges to unlock new frontiers for human progress, fortify national security, and protect critical assets to lead in the race for technological and operational superiority from ground to space.

Forge the Future: Join Voyager Technologies

The future belongs to those who build it. At Voyager Technologies, we’re building technologies that protect lives, expand frontiers and prepare us for what’s next. And we’re doing that with people who are wired to solve, build, adapt and lead. These roles are not for the faint of heart. You’ll help lay the foundation for humanity's future. Join a culture where innovation thrives, curiosity is rewarded, and impact is real. We’re a company of doers, thinkers and builders, united by purpose and grounded in reality. If you want to put your skills to work where the stakes are real and the mission is bigger than any one person, forge the future with Voyager.

Job Summary

Voyager Technologies is seeking a Project Manager to help shape the future of lunar technologies and missions. Advanced Programs leads the company’s earliest stage work, from mission concept definition and long-term technology roadmapping to hands on development of breakthrough technologies that will power our next generation of lunar landers, surface systems, and spacecraft. In this role, you will end-to-end mission concept budgets and schedules for NASA, government, and commercial customers, directly influencing the technologies and architectures that will drive Astrobotic’s future lunar pursuits.

  • Develop program budgets and schedules for new concepts and designs of lunar landers, rovers, surface power systems, and spacecraft.

  • Contribute to programmatic topics such as schedules, resourcing, risks, and budgets estimations.

  • Run internal early technology development projects and paid architecture studies, performing project management over budget, schedule, deliverables, and customer interfacing.

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance or Engineering or related discipline plus 5-10 years of relevant engineering experience. Relevant advanced degree will be considered in lieu of equivalent experience.

  • Experience authoring and decomposing financial and contractual volumes.

The good faith base salary range is $150,000-$200,000 at the time of this posting. Where you fall within the range depends on your experience, skills, and location. This range reflects base salary only and does not include benefits or bonus/incentive. This range may be adjusted in the future.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive
jobs.excerpt: RedHelm is redefining what it means to be a technology partner.
jobs.description:
RedHelm is redefining what it means to be a technology partner. We deliver industry-leading offensive and defensive cybersecurity alongside full-stack IT services that are integrated by design — protecting, powering, and accelerating our clients’ success.

Our teams operate at the intersection of security and technology, combining deep technical expertise with a holistic, client-centered approach. By aligning security strategy, infrastructure, and operational excellence, we help organizations stay resilient in an increasingly complex threat landscape.

At RedHelm, we are building an environment where innovation, accountability, and collaboration drive meaningful outcomes, both for our clients and for the professionals who support them.

About the Role

RedHelm is seeking a Senior Account Executive to drive significant revenue growth through net new customer acquisition and strategic expansion within existing accounts. This is a full-cycle, consultative sales role focused on complex, high-value technology, infrastructure, and managed services solutions.

In this role, you’ll independently manage the entire sales lifecycle (from prospecting and discovery through negotiation and close) while building trusted relationships with executive and technical decision-makers. The ideal candidate is a seasoned seller with strong technical acumen, a proven track record of closing large, complex deals, and the ability to ramp quickly in a fast-paced environment.

Role Focus

  • Primary Objective: Net new customer acquisition and large-account growth
  • Approach: Proactive, consultative, technical, relationship-driven selling
  • Core Skills: Prospecting, relationship management, negotiation, and closing
  • Deal Profile: Complex, multi-solution infrastructure and managed services opportunities
  • Success Metrics: New logos, multi-million-dollar deal closures, pipeline growth, and annual quota attainment
  • Challenges: Managing long sales cycles, overcoming objections, and consistently generating new opportunities

Main Responsibilities

  • Identify, research, and pursue new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, networking, events, referrals, and inbound leads
  • Own the full sales cycle, including discovery, solution alignment, executive presentations, proposal development, negotiation, forecasting, and closing
  • Expand existing accounts by identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities
  • Conduct consultative discovery to understand client business goals, technical environments, and infrastructure needs
  • Develop trusted relationships with decision-makers and key stakeholders
  • Sell complex technology solutions by confidently engaging both technical and executive stakeholders including CIOs, IT Directors, and Finance leaders
  • Stay informed on market trends, competitive landscape, and customer needs to identify growth opportunities
  • Accurately track and report sales activity, pipeline, and performance in CRM tools
  • Develop and maintain a strong, qualified pipeline aligned to annual revenue targets
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams (sales, marketing, product, and leadership) to align strategies and ensure a strong customer experience
  • Will require occasional travel for business purposes

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in a quota-carrying B2B sales role, with a strong focus on new business development
  • Proven success closing complex, high-value technology or infrastructure deals
  • Demonstrated ability to meet or exceed multi-million-dollar annual quotas
  • Established professional network and history of developing business through long-term customer relationships
  • Ability to ramp quickly and produce results with limited formal training or onboarding
  • Experience using CRM platforms and standard productivity tools

Required Skills

  • Strong consultative and solution-based selling capabilities
  • Advanced prospecting, networking, and pipeline-building skills
  • Ability to lead executive-level conversations and presentations
  • Excellent negotiation, objection-handling, and closing skills
  • Strong business acumen and understanding of customer financial drivers
  • Self-directed, competitive, and highly results-oriented
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with technical and cross-functional teams
  • Strong organizational skills and disciplined CRM usage

Required Qualifications and Certifications

  • Working technical knowledge of:
    • Storage infrastructure, SAN and related technologies
    • Security Event Management, SEM, and security services environments
    • Server environments and sizing considerations
    • Major infrastructure and storage vendors
  • Bachelor’s degree
  • Willingness and ability to travel as needed

Additional Information

Compensation

Competitive base salary of $100,000 and uncapped commission

KPIs / Metrics

  • Annual quota attainment, net new and account growth
  • Pipeline generation and progression
  • New logo acquisition
  • Large deal closure performance
  • Scheduled and completed meetings with prospects and customers
  • Sales presentations and solution demos completed
  • Customer outreach activity, calls, emails, meetings, and events
  • Business reviews and follow-ups
  • Referrals generated
  • Ongoing product and sales training participation

Information Security & Data Privacy Responsibility
All employees are responsible for adhering to company Information Security and Privacy Policies and ensuring that all applicable procedures are consistently followed. This includes safeguarding client and company data to maintain its security, availability, and confidentiality, and upholding all legal and regulatory obligations related to data protection. Employees are expected to perform their duties in a manner that prevents security breaches or incidents that compromise business operations, client data, client data, or the company’s financial and operational standing.

Why Join Us

This is an exciting time to join RedHelm as we continue to grow and innovate as a full-stack technology partner. Our integrated approach to offensive security, defensive operations, and IT services creates opportunities to work on complex challenges that directly impact the organizations we serve. As we expand our capabilities and footprint, our team members play a meaningful role in shaping what comes next.

We are equally committed to investing in our people. We believe in a culture where we care about individuals not just for their professional ambitions, but for their personal goals as well. We recognize that work is part of a larger purpose in each person’s life, and that philosophy drives how we support growth, flexibility, and long-term development across our organization.

We offer a comprehensive and competitive benefits package designed to support both career progression and personal wellbeing, including medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) program, paid time off, floating holidays, and paid holidays. More importantly, we provide an environment where you can build meaningful expertise, contribute to forward-thinking solutions, and grow alongside a company that is actively shaping its future.

jobs.excerpt: SALES EXECUTIVETHE OPPORTUNITYIdentity Fusion is seeking an experienced Sales Executive to personally originate, develop, and close enterprise opportunities across North America.
jobs.description:
SALES EXECUTIVE

THE OPPORTUNITY

Identity Fusion is seeking an experienced Sales Executive to personally originate, develop, and close enterprise opportunities across North America. This individual contributor will carry a sales quota and take direct ownership of pipeline generation, executive engagement, strategic pursuits, and revenue attainment.

This is not a traditional sales management position. The successful candidate will be expected to remain actively engaged in the market, develop opportunities through personal relationships and disciplined outbound activity, and lead complex sales pursuits from initial qualification through contract execution.

Identity Fusion is entering an important period of growth as enterprise demand for identity security, Identity and Access Management, managed services, and modern cybersecurity solutions continues to expand. This role offers the opportunity to be at the center of that growth by opening doors, building trusted executive relationships, and converting market opportunity into measurable revenue.

The Sales Executive will sell Identity Fusion’s consulting services, managed services, and strategic software partnerships. The individual will also develop productive relationships with technology vendors, channel partners, advisory firms, and other organizations capable of generating immediate and meaningful sales opportunities.

The ideal candidate is a proven enterprise sales professional who understands that major opportunities are rarely won from behind a desk. They are developed through credibility, persistence, executive access, industry knowledge, and the ability to connect a customer’s business problem to a practical solution.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Enterprise Sales and Revenue Generation

  • Personally originate, qualify, develop, and close enterprise sales opportunities across North America.
  • Carry and consistently achieve or exceed an individual sales quota tied to bookings, revenue, and pipeline objectives.
  • Build a sustainable pipeline through personal networking, targeted outbound activity, referrals, industry relationships, executive introductions, conferences, and partner-generated opportunities.
  • Lead strategic pursuits from initial discovery and qualification through solution development, proposal, negotiation, and contract execution.
  • Maintain direct ownership of the company’s largest and most strategic opportunities until additional sales resources are hired and appropriately transitioned.
  • Sell Identity Fusion’s full portfolio of consulting services, implementation services, advisory services, managed services, and software partner solutions.
  • Develop account strategies that address customer business objectives, security priorities, regulatory pressures, operational risks, and identity modernization requirements.
  • Maintain accurate opportunity, pipeline, forecasting, and customer activity information within the company’s CRM platform.

Executive and Customer Relationships

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with CIOs, CISOs, Chief Risk Officers, IAM leaders, cybersecurity executives, procurement leaders, and other senior stakeholders.
  • Serve as a credible business advisor who can translate identity and cybersecurity challenges into business, operational, financial, and risk-management outcomes.
  • Engage executive sponsors throughout the sales process and maintain strong relationships after contract execution.
  • Expand existing customer relationships by identifying additional consulting, implementation, managed service, and software opportunities.
  • Work closely with delivery and customer leadership to ensure account growth is built upon customer value, successful outcomes, and long-term trust.
  • Represent Identity Fusion at customer meetings, executive briefings, industry conferences, partner events, and other strategic market activities.

Strategic Pursuits and Solution Development

  • Lead complex enterprise pursuits involving multiple stakeholders, technical requirements, procurement processes, partner relationships, and extended sales cycles.
  • Coordinate with solution architects, delivery leaders, vendor partners, and executive management to develop compelling and achievable customer solutions.
  • Support the development of proposals, statements of work, pricing strategies, executive presentations, and contract negotiations.
  • Understand customer buying processes, funding cycles, decision criteria, competitive alternatives, and organizational priorities.
  • Maintain momentum throughout lengthy sales cycles and establish clear next steps, decision points, and mutual action plans.
  • Provide market intelligence, competitive information, and customer feedback to the CRO and executive leadership team.

Channel and Partner Development

  • Develop relationships with technology vendors, advisory firms, integrators, resellers, cloud providers, and strategic alliance partners that can produce immediate sales opportunities.
  • Create joint account plans and coordinated pursuit strategies with selected partners.
  • Identify opportunities where Identity Fusion can support vendor implementation, modernization, migration, advisory, or managed service requirements.
  • Develop referral relationships with organizations and individuals that have access to enterprise IAM and cybersecurity decision-makers.
  • Ensure partner relationships are measured by qualified opportunities and revenue contribution rather than activity alone.

Market Presence and Business Development

  • Establish a visible and credible presence within the identity security, IAM, cybersecurity, and digital transformation markets.
  • Participate in industry conferences, customer events, executive forums, webinars, and networking activities.
  • Use professional relationships, market knowledge, and thought leadership to initiate conversations with prospective customers.
  • Travel as necessary for customer meetings, conferences, partner sessions, and strategic pursuits.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to support targeted campaigns, executive outreach, events, content, and account-based marketing initiatives.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Ten or more years of successful enterprise sales experience within cybersecurity, Identity and Access Management, enterprise software, SaaS, technology consulting, managed services, or related markets.
  • A demonstrated record of personally originating and closing complex enterprise opportunities.
  • Experience carrying and achieving a significant individual sales quota.
  • Established relationships with enterprise CIOs, CISOs, IAM executives, cybersecurity leaders, technology vendors, and industry partners.
  • Strong understanding of complex enterprise sales cycles, consultative selling, value-based selling, and solution-oriented sales methodologies.
  • Demonstrated ability to build pipeline through direct networking, outbound activity, referrals, partners, and executive relationships.
  • Experience selling professional services, consulting services, implementation services, managed services, or enterprise software solutions.
  • Ability to lead opportunities involving multiple internal and external stakeholders, lengthy decision cycles, formal procurement processes, and complex contractual requirements.
  • Strong executive communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-development skills.
  • Experience developing proposals, pricing strategies, account plans, pursuit strategies, and revenue forecasts.
  • Ability to operate independently, maintain disciplined sales activity, and remain accountable for measurable revenue results.
  • Willingness and ability to travel for customer meetings, conferences, partner events, and strategic pursuits.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

  • Experience selling Identity and Access Management, identity governance, customer identity, privileged access management, authentication, authorization, identity orchestration, or identity security solutions.
  • Experience selling a combination of consulting services, managed services, and software partner solutions.
  • Existing relationships within enterprise IAM, cybersecurity, financial services, healthcare, insurance, government, critical infrastructure, or other regulated industries.
  • Experience working with software vendors, cloud providers, systems integrators, MSSPs, VARs, and strategic alliance partners.
  • Experience supporting vendor-led implementation opportunities and jointly pursuing enterprise accounts.
  • Familiarity with identity modernization, Zero Trust, cloud security, regulatory compliance, cyber-risk reduction, and enterprise transformation programs.
  • Prior experience working directly with a CRO, CEO, or senior executive leadership team in a growth-oriented organization.

PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS

The Sales Executive will be evaluated primarily on measurable sales performance, including:

  • Individual quota attainment
  • Qualified pipeline generation
  • New enterprise customers
  • Expansion revenue from existing accounts
  • Strategic opportunities originated and closed
  • Partner-generated opportunities and revenue
  • Forecast accuracy and sales discipline

Success in this role will be defined by revenue produced, relationships established, opportunities advanced, and customers won.

COMPENSATION INFORMATION

The compensation package includes a base salary and an performance-based commission structure aligned with individual sales results. The final compensation package will be determined based on experience, qualifications, geographic location, industry relationships, demonstrated sales performance, and overall fit for the role.

Additional incentives may include annual performance bonuses, management-by-objective participation, equity grants, and other company-sponsored reward programs.

BENEFITS — WHY IDENTITY FUSION?

Identity Fusion offers competitive compensation, high earning potential, a flexible remote work environment, comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, life and disability insurance, paid holidays, and flexible paid time off.

The Sales Executive will work directly with executive leadership and have a meaningful role in shaping the company’s growth across North America. This is an opportunity for a proven sales professional to take ownership of significant enterprise opportunities, represent a respected identity security organization, and build a substantial book of business in one of cybersecurity’s most important markets.

ABOUT IDENTITY FUSION

Identity Fusion helps organizations strengthen their cybersecurity posture through advanced identity security, access governance, risk management, consulting, implementation, and managed service solutions. We enable enterprises to protect critical assets, reduce operational risk, and modernize identity-driven security strategies in an increasingly complex digital environment.

Join us in building the future of identity security.

jobs.title: Controller
jobs.excerpt: Vannevar is a defense technology company building AI to deter our adversaries.
jobs.description:
Vannevar is a defense technology company building AI to deter our adversaries. In the 21st century, conflict moves at algorithmic speed and foresight equals firepower. Our agentic AI is purpose-built to compete with China—from cross-Strait conflict to gray zone coercion. Trained on the most mission-relevant datasets in defense, our technology models adversary behavior, simulates campaigns, and recommends the best course of action to decision makers. Our AI systems are some of the most trusted in the industry and actively used on the front lines of the Indo-Pacific to keep the peace and save lives.

Exceptional technology starts with exceptional people. Vannevar is a small agile team combining world-class engineers with veteran strategists who bring deep expertise in defense and tradecraft. We’re building a company defined by mission impact, user empathy, and disciplined growth. In just three years, we grew from $3M to $80M in ARR, achieved early profitability, and reached unicorn status—proving that disruption doesn’t require an ego, and staying power doesn’t mean standing still.

About the role

We're looking for a controller to help us bring order to chaos. You are ambitious and thrive in a fast-paced and quickly evolving environment, but are also detailed, process oriented, and organized. You are strategic. You’re focused on where we’re going and build the plans and processes to support our goals. You are analytically rigorous. You have a deep bias towards using data and analyses to drive decisions. Your second language is performance metrics and you have a deep understanding of how to continue improving those metrics. You’re excited to iterate. At this point we’re still learning. You’re energized by the prospect of creating new tools and processes to make the company operate more effectively, and not afraid to make changes when the first, or second, attempt can be improved.

As the Controller, you’ll work not only on traditional accounting tasks – monthly close process, accounts payable, payroll, financial reporting, tax planning, and compliance – but also play a critical role in building the processes and workflows to lay the groundwork for scaling an efficient and effective finance organization as the organization grows. This role reports to the Head of Finance.

What you’ll do

Modernize the finance stack

  • Lead the migration from QuickBooks to a modern AI-first ERP (DualEntry, Rillet, Campfire, or similar) and — when required, likely in 2027 — add an inventory management system
  • Build automations and AI-native workflows into close, AP, AR, expense, and reporting — replacing manual process wherever possible and enabling more granular and accurate financial data for business decisions
  • Be opinionated about which workflows belong in finance vs. the broader business, particularly in a fast-growing start-up context

Own the books, close, and controls

  • Lead month-end close, financial reporting, audit, tax, and compliance
  • Own AP, AR, payroll, GL, T&E with one direct report (initially)
  • Ensure timeliness, accuracy, and audit-readiness across all accounting functions

Partner on the decisions, not just the reports

  • Partner with the Head of Finance on the design of product- and customer-level cost accounting; own the implementation. Bring creative thinking to a hard problem — getting accurate product / customer economics without imposing on daily operations of the rest of the company. This reporting informs product investment decisions, pricing strategy, and sales / engineering strategy.
  • Be a thought partner on reporting that reflects what the business is actually doing and that informs upcoming strategic and operational decisions
  • Assist with investor communications and in translating finance for non-finance leaders

What we’re looking for

  • CPA + bachelor's or higher in Accounting or Finance
  • 8+ years of accounting experience, with some as a Controller
  • Strong knowledge of U.S. GAAP and financial reporting; Big 4 company audit experience
  • Unwavering detail orientation. This role gets the books right first. Big-picture business sense is a real plus — and we hope you bring it — but it doesn't substitute for accuracy and rigor.
  • Comfort building automations, ideally that incorporate AI — you don't wait for IT or vendors to ship the tools you need
  • Demonstrated ability to master a new business-critical domain. This role spans specialized areas — modern ERPs, AI-first tooling, cost accounting, government compliance and, in the future, manufacturing — and no single candidate will have direct experience in all of them. We're looking for evidence you've learned a hard new domain quickly in service of a business objective.
  • Startup pragmatism: gets the details right without imposing process on the rest of the business
  • US Person; clearance eligible

Big plus

  • Led the migration of a foundational system (ERP, inventory management, billing, or similar) in a startup culture — migrating to a modern AI-first ERP is an additional plus
  • Hands-on operator in a modern ERP (e.g., NetSuite, Sage Intacct, DualEntry, Rillet, Campfire) — experience in an AI-first system is a plus, but we really want to see that you know how to maximize the business value of the tools that you’re using
  • Manufacturing / inventory accounting(we anticipate entering manufacturing in 2027)
  • Cost accounting depth that enables you to creatively problem solve novel allocation questions (cost allocation, customer profitability, R&D economics)
  • Government cost accounting familiarity, including an awareness of how to work with CAS / DCAA requirements
  • Institutional investor relations / due diligence support
  • Strong communication with non-finance partners (product, engineering, GTM)

Nice to have

  • SaaS / software accounting experience
  • GovTech / defense industry experience specifically
  • Pre-IPO scale-up experience

Note to candidates: you'll either lead our QuickBooks → modern ERP migration, or land in a freshly-implemented new system — comfort building in a new ERP is essential either way.

What we offer

We’re proud to offer competitive benefits that support our employees. Some key highlights of our benefits package include:
  • Health, dental, and vision insurance
  • Remote friendly with WeWork access
  • Unlimited PTO, shared downtime during the federal holiday calendar, and company-wide off time at the end of each year
  • 401(k) match
  • Lifestyle & wellbeing stipends
  • Salary top-up during military reserve duty
  • Fully paid parental leave
  • Child and pet care reimbursement during travel
Vannevar is an equal opportunity employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.
We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply, even if you don't feel like you're a perfect fit. If you're passionate about contributing to our mission, we'd love to hear from you!
IMPORTANT NOTICE
We are committed to protecting the privacy of all applicants. Official emails from the company will come from an @vannevarlabs.com domain. Under no circumstances will a legitimate representative from our company contact you to request passwords, financial information, or other sensitive personal data. Please be vigilant of potential scams.

  • Perform Finance application user provisioning, including managing change request tickets relating to those applications
  • Lead as the primary resource that manages the Finance applications ticket boards
  • Collaborate with senior Finance leadership to gather regularly updated priorities regarding the change pipeline and open tickets
  • Troubleshoot issues and outages in the Finance software and integrations

  • Review upcoming application updates and software releases. Plan and lead the testing of impacted processes in collaboration with the Finance process owners
  • Develop expertise to assist in training staff on new Finance technologies, processes, and systems
  • Assist with creation of technical documentation, manuals, and IT policies for Finance applications

  • Excellent English written and verbal communication skills
  • 4-6 years of Oracle Fusion Cloud Financials professional corporate work experience

jobs.description:
Thermal Works LLC has an exciting opportunity for a Logistics Coordinator to join our team, to support the day-to-day coordination of transportation, shipment documentation, and delivery tracking across ThermalWorks' domestic and international operations. The Logistics Coordinator serves as a key resource within the logistics function, supporting shipment visibility, carrier communication, document management, and reporting activities. This role is responsible for coordinating transportation, maintaining shipment documentation, tracking deliveries, and ensuring accurate logistics records across manufacturing partner locations in the United States, Europe, and Asia, and customer destinations across North America, Europe, and other international markets.

The ideal candidate is highly organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced remote environment.

Thermal Works values efficiency and strives to maintain smooth operations. Our primary focus is on providing an integrated cooling system for data centers and commercial buildings that dramatically reduces the energy demand, water consumption and cost of cooling. It transforms the economics and eco-metrics of commercial cooling with zero water solutions that outperform air- and water-cooled systems in any climate.

Thermal Works solutions are sustainable and cutting-edge. For that reason, we are highly selective about the people we bring on board because our work depends on it. Change and progress happen quickly, and we must be able to trust one another to be honest, communicative, reliable, and self-motivated. We seek ultra-creatives and superstar performers with a sense of humility and a hunger to make a positive impact in the world. We offer flexibility and endless growth opportunities to those who can harness their skills and talents and identify how and where to use them to add value. Thermal Works is one of several “inspired infrastructure” companies that work collaboratively under our parent company, Endeavour Energy, LLC. At the heart of this ecosystem is a diverse group of bright, passionate, dedicated people, working together to make a real difference for people and the planet. Thermal Works is looking for someone to join our team to help us move the needle towards sustainable change. Are you ready to join the journey?

Key Responsibilities

Include but are not limited to:

  • Coordinate domestic and international shipments through approved transportation providers, including standard freight, heavy haul, and specialized equipment transportation.
  • Create, review, and maintain shipping documentation, including bills of lading, commercial invoices, packing lists, certificates of origin, and related logistics records.
  • Monitor shipment status and provide proactive updates to internal stakeholders regarding delays, exceptions, and delivery confirmations.
  • Maintain accurate shipment tracking information and logistics records in company systems.
  • Communicate with carriers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders regarding shipment activity.
  • Assist with transportation scheduling and carrier appointment coordination at manufacturing partner sites and customer delivery locations.
  • Support proof of delivery collection and document retention requirements.
  • Maintain organized electronic shipment records and documentation in accordance with company procedures and retention requirements.
  • Assist with special logistics projects and continuous improvement initiatives as assigned.
  • Perform other duties as assigned in support of Operations and Supply Chain activities.

Education and Experience

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor's or Associate degree in Business, Supply Chain, Logistics, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant work experience.
  • Minimum of four years of experience in logistics, transportation, shipping, supply chain, customer service, or related operational support functions.
  • Working knowledge of domestic and international transportation processes, shipping documentation, and logistics coordination activities.
  • Demonstrated experience coordinating shipments and communicating with carriers, suppliers, customers, freight forwarders, customs brokers, or transportation providers.
  • Strong organizational, time management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications, particularly Excel and Outlook.
  • Ability to work independently and effectively in a remote work environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and commitment to data accuracy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Direct experience coordinating shipments of industrial equipment, HVAC equipment, data center cooling equipment, or comparable specialized freight.
  • Direct experience with international logistics, including customs documentation, tariff considerations, and cross-border shipping requirements.
  • Experience coordinating logistics for contract manufacturing operations across multiple geographies.
  • Working knowledge of transportation management systems, enterprise resource planning platforms, or comparable logistics tracking software.

Working Conditions

  • Remote position, with core working hours overlapping the Operations team's schedule and flexibility required to accommodate coordination with counterparts in multiple time zones.
  • Standard business hours, with occasional after-hours availability required during time-sensitive shipment events or delivery situations.

Enjoy…

A fast-paced, entrepreneurial culture focused on innovation.

A flexible, autonomous work environment.

A culture of respect, learning, and excellence.
Experienced, highly talented experts as team peers.
Growth and travel opportunities.
A team of change-makers having a significant impact on people and the planet.

About Our Parent Company, Endeavour Energy

Endeavour is the main hub—a self-sustaining incubation platform for innovation—within a larger ecosystem focused on sustainable infrastructure. It provides the space, time, and all necessary resources to take advanced technologies from ideation through development to launch. Every day we are helping innovators to develop and launch global solutions to tackle global challenges, which is no easy task. Our teams work extremely hard because we all believe in Endeavour’s mission: to guarantee clean water and renewable energy to everyone, everywhere. As we look to the future, Endeavour intends to remain at the forefront of innovation, taking on grander challenges based on the needs of our clients and of local economies. jobs.description:
About the Role

ServiceNow is building something genuinely innovative in CRM — and we need the people to match. This isn't a "storytelling" seat. It's a builder seat. You'll own how our CRM message hits the market and how our field actually uses it. That means writing the things sellers say, building the tools they use, running the programs that move pipeline — and doing it fast.

If you've spent your career making decks look beautiful but haven't seen a deal close or a campaign activate, this probably isn't the right fit. If you thrive at the intersection of message, motion, and market — and you've got the receipts to prove it — keep reading.

What You'll Do

This role spans the full product marketing motion for ServiceNow Sales CRM, including:

GTM Activation

  • Partner with Sales, Demand Gen, and Field Marketing to make sure messaging actually travels — not just to decks, but to deals
  • Build launch plans and run them. Own the milestones, drive the cross-functional coordination, close out the execution
  • Identify gaps in how the field positions CRM and build the content and programs to close them

Sales Enablement

  • Create the tools sellers use every day — pitch decks, talk tracks, battle cards, discovery frameworks, competitive objection handlers
  • Run enablement sessions that actually stick — live training, recorded content, whatever format gets adoption
  • Work closely with sales leadership and frontline reps to understand what's working in market and what's not

Competitive Intelligence

  • Know how ServiceNow stacks up against the competition and the broader field — and build content that arms sellers to win
  • Track market moves, synthesize what matters, and get it in front of the right people quickly

Content & Programs

  • Build assets across the full funnel — thought leadership, event programs, customer stories, analyst materials
  • Prioritize ruthlessly. You'll have a lot on your plate; knowing what to say no to is as important as knowing what to build

Messaging & Positioning

  • Own the narrative for how ServiceNow wins in CRM — from value proposition to competitive frame to category definition
  • Translate product capabilities into customer-facing messaging that lands with CROs, RevOps leaders, and sales teams
  • Keep the message current as the product and competitive landscape evolve — this isn't a set-it-and-forget-it job

What We're Looking For

We're not requiring a traditional product marketing background. We care far more about what you've shipped and activated than what your title has been. Strong candidates likely come from one or more of these backgrounds:

  • Product marketing, solutions marketing, or competitive intelligence
  • Sales enablement or revenue enablement leadership
  • Demand generation or field marketing with a strong message ownership component
  • GTM strategy or go-to-market leadership in a B2B SaaS environment

Regardless of background, here's what we need to see:

  • You've owned a GTM motion end-to-end — not contributed to one, owned one. You know what it took to get it across the line.
  • You've built things sellers actually use. If your battle card lives in a drawer, that's a problem.
  • You work well with sales. Not adjacent to sales — with them. You understand how deals get made.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and operate without a fully paved road.
  • You have strong opinions and the judgment to know when to hold them and when to let go.
  • CRM, sales tech, or enterprise SaaS domain knowledge is a plus — but raw reps in the market matter more than category fluency.

To be successful in this role you have:

  • 6+ years of experience in product marketing, sales enablement, GTM strategy, demand gen, or a combination
  • Proven track record of building and activating GTM programs that drove measurable outcomes (pipeline, win rate, field adoption — any of these)
  • Experience working in or closely alongside enterprise sales organizations
  • Strong written communication — this role requires a lot of it and it needs to be good
  • Comfortable presenting to and working with senior stakeholders, including sales leadership and executives
  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

What Success Looks Like in Year One

  • The field has a clear, consistent CRM narrative — and they're actually using it

  • Product launches hit the market with crisp activation plans and tight cross-functional execution
  • Sellers have the tools they need to win competitive deals, and those tools are built into how they sell
  • You've built strong working relationships with Sales, Product, and Marketing partners across the org
  • You've established a reputation for getting things done, even when it's complicated

jobs.description:
About Bodwé Group Companies

Bodwé is the Professional Services Group of Mno-Bmadsen, the investment enterprise and a wholly owned instrumentality of the Pokagon Band of Potawatomi. We are architects, planners, consultants, designers, engineers, scientists, and federal contractors, committed to growing the economy and legacy of the Pokagon Band and supporting its more than 6,000 citizens. By integrating expertise across architecture, engineering, construction, and facility management, we deliver holistic, end-to-end solutions that drive efficiency and deliver distinctive outcomes.

Position Summary

The Senior Proposal Manager role is responsible for owning the RFP, RFI, RFQ, working directly with Capture to final submission to the government. This role develops, manages, and records technical aspects of the project, working closely with the BD Capture team, project coordinators, and internal/external SMEs. You own the management, organization, compliance, and quality of proposal content, price-to-win strategies, conceptual designs, presentations, graphics development, and production. This position is responsible for multiple concurrent submission deliverables, CRM maintenance and organization, file organization, writing, editing, and QA of submission documents. This position serves as a mentor to junior level staff on the team.

Accommodation Requests

We are committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, contact our

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

The following inexhaustive list of duties represents a sample of work routinely performed by this role:

  • Manages highly complex RFPs and IDIQs.
  • Develops pre-proposal tools and documentation including compliance matrices, proposal outlines; assigns pre-proposal activities and reviews to in-house SMEs, and teaming partners.
  • Write or initiate development of content for proposals (such as technical approach, staffing plan, past performance, resumes, etc.) and other promotional materials or client deliverables.
  • Create other proposal elements (i.e., graphics, charts, tables, appendices) in support of proposal development.
  • Follow and manage Shipley process for proposal color team reviews.
  • Coordinate and communicate clear requirements to the Graphic Designer for compelling graphics for proposals.
  • Coordinate with decentralized staff to solicit feedback and content for proposals.
  • Enhance text received from other members of the team as needed.
  • Conduct research as needed into federal clients, teaming partners, and competitors to enhance our competitive advantage.
  • Write, edit or re-write portions of technical documents to improve flow, organization, and content.
  • Understand bid strategies as they evolve; develop methods for integrating/capturing the final bid strategy in the proposal.
  • Ensure proposal outline/formatting complies with solicitation requirements.
  • Own final document from a format, compliance, and quality standpoint
  • Develop and maintain cloud content library for proposal materials and ensure the information is organized and current, developing an appropriate metadata tagging taxonomy to help content contributors find relevant content easily and quickly.
  • Maintain past performance library and ensure that past performance templates remain current in close coordination with delivery project leads.
  • Participate in other business development requirements such as opportunity tracking, pipeline management, and staff training on proposal methodology.
  • Be highly organized and administer activities such as calendar development, scheduling meetings, consolidating feedback, and developing weekly communications on key opportunities.

Qualifications and Experience

Education + Degree

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Business, English, Journalism, Communications, or a related field.

Experience, Certification, + Professional Skills

  • 7-10 years of federal proposal experience.
  • Minimum of 1 year of people management experience.
  • Experience working with SF1449’s.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, excellent organizational abilities, and technical skills.
  • Understanding of FAR/RFO and how to interpret and apply them to solicitation and deliverables.
  • Demonstrated ability to interact in a cooperative and effective manner.
  • Self-motivated, able to multi-task, ability to work independently, take initiative, set priorities, and see projects through to completion.
  • Strong service orientation.
  • Ability to work with technical SMEs.
  • APMP Certified Practitioner.
  • Experience working on a Federal Capture Team.
  • Preferred: Prior experience working with a Tribal entity.
  • Must have or be able to obtain and maintain a Real ID or Passport in order to undergo commercial airfare travel.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite, including Word, Excel, Outlook, and Teams.
  • Proficiency in Adobe Creative Cloud.
  • Familiarity with GovWin or similar.

Working Environment

This is a remote position that will require some (≤ 10%) travel to headquarters, client sites, or conferences.

This position operates in a professional office setting. The role routinely uses standard office equipment such as computers, phones, printers, and photocopiers. The work environment is generally quiet and free from exposure to loud noise, hazardous materials, or heavy machinery. Employees are typically seated for extended periods and may occasionally move about the office to attend meetings or access equipment and supplies.

Physical Demands

Sitting/Standing: This role is generally sedentary, performing sitting work utilizing technological office equipment, including a laptop, mouse, keyboard, computer monitors, telephones, scanners, and copiers.

Walking: This role requires the ability to move about inside the office to access the required technological equipment.

The Regional Director of Quality Assurance and Monitoring supports regional operations by serving on the Regional Ops team, consults with and supports facility Medical Records Directors to achieve operational excellence in records keeping ind quality assurance. Imagine being part of a team that’s not just shaping the future but actively driving it. As a vital part of the global Davies Group, we help businesses navigate risk, optimize operations, and spearhead transformation in the insurance and regulated sectors.

Davies North America is seeking an experienced Medical Only Adjuster to join our claims team. This position is responsible for investigating, evaluating, and managing assigned workers’ compensation medical-only claims in accordance with company standards, client expectations, and applicable state regulations.
The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of workers’ compensation claims handling, Florida workers’ compensation statutes, medical terminology, claim investigation, reserving, and return-to-work coordination.   • Proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Word, Excel, and Outlook.

  • Florida workers’ compensation claims handling experience.

jobs.excerpt: The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD) About Sezzle:With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible.
jobs.description:
The salary range for this role is $5,000 - $9,500 per month (Gross in USD)

About Sezzle:

With a mission to financially empower the next generation, Sezzle is revolutionizing the shopping experience beyond payments, blending cutting-edge tech with seamless, interest-free installment plans that make shopping smarter and more accessible. We’re not just transforming payments; we’re redefining how people discover, interact with, and purchase the things they love while driving real impact on merchant sales through increased conversions and higher order values. As we continue to shape the future of fintech and retail, we’re building an innovative, dynamic team passionate about creating more than just a transaction but a truly unique shopping journey. If you’re excited about pushing boundaries in tech and delivering a game-changing experience for consumers and merchants alike, come join us at Sezzle and help create the future of shopping!

Compensation:

For this senior development role, with 8+ years of experience, the compensation range is $5,000 - $9,500 USD per month. This range acknowledges the extensive expertise, leadership capabilities, and significant contributions expected at this level, offering a competitive salary to reflect the value of advanced skills and experience.

About the Role:

We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior Software Engineer who is best in class with a high IQ plus a high EQ. This role presents an exciting opportunity to thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment within a rapidly growing team, with abundant prospects for career advancement.

As a Senior Software Engineer with Sezzle, you will work with a highly-motivated team to tackle interesting and challenging problems across multiple areas of the organization. Your experience and guidance will help other members of the team level-up their own skills as well.

In this backend focused role, you will work closely with stakeholders from Product, Support and the business. You’ll also partner with other engineering teams to provide high-quality, scalable, and innovative solutions to internal and customer problems. Your day-to-day responsibilities will include designing, developing, and delivering new features, as well as unblocking and mentoring your teammates.

This role has both an internal and external focus, your contributions will make a meaningful difference in the day-to-day lives of your peers at Sezzle, enhancing their ability to support our business and customers, and you will have opportunities to take any feedback and iterate.

Interview Process

We believe transparency is important at Sezzle. Regularly providing feedback while setting expectations is part of our culture starting with the interview process. Advancement through each step is not guaranteed.

  • Application submitted (you are here)
  • Wonderlic test (30-40 min)
  • Interview with recruiters (30 min)
  • Coding assessment (~1.5 hours)
  • Interview with engineers (1 hour)
  • Interview with engineering leadership (30-45 min)
  • Offer!

What You'll Do:

  • Design software applications and features in Golang and React
  • Help build out a distributed architecture, creating solutions that work within it, maintaining consistency while scaling highly
  • Coordinate with internal company stakeholders to design market winning products
  • Develop and collect metrics to drive continuous improvement of existing products
  • Deliver high quality features which can be tested and adheres to reporting standards
  • As needed, lead small development teams to bring a project to market
  • Mentor other engineering teammates to help elevate their experience and knowledge

What We Look For:

  • At least 7 years of full-stack software engineering experience
  • Experience bringing new ideas and building consensus on the path forward
  • Experience with building and serving REST APIs using Go (preferably) and Java Python or a similar language.
  • Experience working in a distributed, cloud-based architecture, with either design patterns like transactional outboxes, or queuing tools like RabbitMQ, SQS, Kafka
  • Demonstrated experience working with Claude or equivalent large language model tools is required; candidates must be comfortable leveraging AI to enhance productivity, research, and communication.
  • Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

Preferred Knowledge and Skills:

  • Experience with SQL based RDMS through an ORM tool
  • Comfortable using observability platforms like Prometheus, or vendor solutions like NewRelic or Datadog to instrument your code for production monitoring and alerting.
  • DevOps experience with CI/CD pipelines
  • Familiarity with containerized micro-service architecture deployed with Kubernetes on AWS
  • Demonstrated history of delivering commercial APIs and web applications
  • A clear record of getting products to market and prioritizing solutions and improvements based on stakeholder/customer feedback.

About You:

  • You have relentlessly high standards - many people may think your standards are unreasonably high. You are continually raising the bar and driving those around you to deliver great results. You make sure that defects do not get sent down the line and that problems are fixed so they stay fixed.
  • You’re not bound by convention - your success—and much of the fun—lies in developing new ways to do things
  • You need action - speed matters in business. Many decisions and actions are reversible and do not need extensive study. We value calculated risk-taking.
  • You earn trust - you listen attentively, speak candidly, and treat others respectfully.
  • You have backbone; disagree, then commit - you can respectfully challenge decisions when you disagree, even when doing so is uncomfortable or exhausting. You have conviction and are tenacious. You do not compromise for the sake of social cohesion. Once a decision is determined, you commit wholly.
  • You deliver results - you focus on the key inputs and deliver them with the right quality and in a timely fashion. Despite setbacks, you rise to the occasion and never settle.

Sezzle’s Technology Stack:

  • Languages: Golang, Typescript, Python
  • Frontend: Typescript - React and React Native
  • Backend: Golang
  • Database: MySQL, Postgres, Elasticsearch
  • DevOps & Cloud: AWS, Kubernetes
  • Version Control: Git
  • CI/CD: Gitlab
  • Testing: Developer-driven, focus on automated unit, integration, and end-to-end tests
  • Sezzle is focused on using open source, and we build what we can before buying!

What Makes Working at Sezzle Awesome?

At Sezzle, we are more than just brilliant engineers, passionate data enthusiasts, out-of-the-box thinkers, and determined innovators; we are skilled musicians, yogis, cyclists, chefs, golfers, dog-lovers, and rock-climbers. We believe in surrounding ourselves with not only the best and the brightest individuals, but those that are unique and purpose-driven in all that they do. Our culture is not defined by a certain set of perks designed to give the illusion of the traditional startup culture, but rather, it is the visible example living in every employee that we hire.

Principal Engineer (P&C), is responsible for leading, reviewing, assessing, and approving Protection and Control design submissions for National Grid and/or Distribution Network Operator (DNO) projects. This role ensures that designs for substations, transformers, switchgear, and other HV infrastructure comply with National Grid / DNO engineering standards, regulatory requirements, and industry best practices.

The successful candidate will work closely with the DNO's, Contractors, internal Engineering and Design teams, and Project Managers to ensure the timely delivery of safe, reliable, and compliant designs.

Experience of the UK Electricity Transmission and/or Distribution System is preferable, but not essential for this role.

Responsibilities

Design Review & Approval:

  • Review and assess P&C design submissions, ensuring compliance with National Grid / DNO policies, procedures and engineering standards.
  • Provide detailed feedback and recommendations to address design gaps, non-compliance, or potential risks.
  • Approve final designs once all technical, safety, and regulatory requirements are met.
  • Chair design review meetings with a variety of stakeholders.
  • Coordination and technical interface with other engineering disciplines.

Stakeholder Coordination:

  • Serve as the primary point of contact between National Grid / DNO and Contractors regarding P&C design matters.
  • Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including asset management, project delivery teams, and other engineering disciplines, to ensure design alignment with project objectives.
  • Participate in design coordination meetings, workshops, and technical reviews with contractors and suppliers.

Risk Identification & Mitigation:

  • Identify potential risks related to safety, reliability, and performance in contractor designs and recommend corrective actions.
  • Ensure that all designs incorporate appropriate risk mitigation measures, including hazard identification (HAZID) and risk assessments.
  • Experience of implementing safety by design and CDM awareness.

Documentation & Reporting:

  • Maintain comprehensive records of design submissions, review comments, and approval decisions.
  • Prepare technical reports and assurance documentation for internal stakeholders and regulatory bodies.
  • Monitor performance related to design quality and compliance, providing feedback to management as needed.
  • Experience of working to a structure project design process.

Essential:

  • HNC or Degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, or a related discipline.
  • Proven experience in P&C design, design assurance, or technical approval within the Electricity Transmission and/or DNO sector.
  • Strong knowledge of HV infrastructure, including substations, transformers, switchgear, and HV Cable.

Desirable:

  • Chartered Engineer status or working towards CEng accreditation.
  • Experience of producing, reviewing and approving designs for National Grid and/or Distribution Network Operator (DNO) projects.
  • Currently or previously held National Grid BP141 Design Assurance Engineer authorisation.
  • Currently or previously nominated as BP137 Contractor Design Approval Engineer on National Grid projects.

Location:

Home based / Can be based anywhere in the UK, with the option of working from Omnia offices (Stafford, Stockton Heath and Northallerton), as per project requirements. Must be willing to travel anywhere throughout the UK.

Working Hours:

Ideally full time but may consider part time staff positions.

Package:

  • Competitive Salary, plus discretionary bonus.
  • Working hours of 40 hours per week. All overtime payable or time off in lieu (your choice) should you work more than this.
  • 22 days holiday, plus bank holidays with an option to increase.
  • Private Medical Insurance.
  • Workplace Pension.
  • Death in Service.
  • Company car scheme.

Egis is a leading global architecture, consulting, construction engineering and operating firm. We work side by side with clients to build a more balanced, sustainable and resilient world.

Omnia Projects, part of the Egis Group, are a UK-based engineering consultancy specialising in electricity Transmission and Distribution (T&D) providing engineering, project management and technical assurance.

Provide guidance on deal structuring to optimize revenue outcomes and ensure compliance with GAAP. Serve as consultative resource to go-to-market teams prior to launching sales plays, partner programs, and sales incentive programs.

  • SaaS Metrics: Provide insights into key SaaS performance indicators (ARR, Churn, Net Retention, etc.) and how they intersect with GAAP revenue.

WHAT YOU BRING
